description:
平贴5窑炉
短款

美美丽丽5窑炉，电力节点一线天。
超级回流流出水，闲铅美美回核中。

Flat-Fit 5 Kilns
Short Edition

Five beautiful kilns, lined beneath a single strip of power nodes.
Super-flow carries the water away, while spare lead flows gracefully back to the core.
